notes: USAGE-v1 price table. Deliberately shipped with an empty model map.
No verified provider rate card was available to this batch, and CONTRACTS USAGE-v1 forbids inventing rates to fill a gap.
An entry only becomes usable once rates, currency, effectiveAt, verifiedAt and source are all present and reviewed.
A missing entry or a null rate MUST produce knownCost=null (or a labelled lower bound) and costComplete=false, never 0.

fields.currency: ISO 4217 code; never mixed across currencies when aggregating
fields.effectiveAt: ISO 8601 instant the rate card took effect; a record may not use a rate younger than its own request time
fields.verifiedAt: ISO 8601 instant the rate card was last verified against the provider; null means unverified
fields.source: provenance of the rate card (documentation URL or reviewed ticket id); value is not a secret

rates.input: price per million non-cached input tokens
